subject: Image 1 is the APPROVED pixel-art style and object-design reference. Draw a NEW ISOLATED GAME SPRITE of only the upright wooden streetlamp near its center. NOT a scene, NOT a crop or a repaint of the landscape. It must be the SAME DESIGN FAMILY: a very tall thin straight brown wooden POST, topped directly by a compact three-dimensional lantern with a chunky very dark ink-blue pagoda / pyramidal cap, thick black-blue framing and pale ochre yellow glass. Three-quarter fixed high-angle RPG view, vertical sides, front and right side of the lantern distinguishable. NO horizontal arm, NO hanging pendant, NO stone lamppost. At target native sprite scale it must occupy about 28 pixels wide by 102 pixels tall; make a deliberately small 28x102-ish LOGICAL PIXEL sprite and enlarge it cleanly with large square pixels, not a detailed HD illustration. The roof is widest, the wooden pole is around 6 native pixels thick, and the bottom is a narrow squared wooden foot, no cobblestones, no ground. 1-2 native pixel continuous dark ink outline. Broad connected limited-colour clusters in the reference style. Flat material albedo, brown wood and blue-black metal; glass pale yellow but NO light rays or halo, no bloom, no exterior illumination, no warm light spill painted on the post or frame. Everything outside the object is flat exact bright magenta #ff00ff, NO gradient, NO checkerboard. No shadows, no reflection, no floor, no background, no person, no text. Center the sole sprite with clear magenta margin. Keep the complete post and cap inside the image. The purpose is a runtime relightable game sprite, NOT a night beauty render.
style: Reference-matched readable low-resolution pixel art, chunky connected clusters and dark ink contour, no antialiasing, no microtexture, no dithering.
lighting: Neutral even albedo-only illumination; no cast shadow or environment light. The renderer will add emitted light later.
